highest_admissible_claim: JANUS has recovered the exact historical LinearAInscriptions.js input identified by the Briakos thesis receipt and admitted a non-executing JavaScript-Map-compatible parser for that source. A clean replay on those exact bytes does not reproduce the published Briakos metric vector under the frozen JANUS method manifest; multiple predeclared or externally fixed 419-scope explanations were tested and rejected without post-hoc subset search, so the public corpus-selection/method scope remains unresolved rather than refuted. The related historical annotations.js repository candidate is strongly supported by two independent path-history transports and by an exact match between the thesis numeric size 2201442 and the decoded Unicode code-point count, while its raw UTF-8 size is 2239932; JANUS does not infer the author's measurement implementation or claim a byte-count-exact receipt. The annotation identity layer does not reconstruct the 419-document corpus. External logos D5 and corrected D6 source-layer defects were replayed as prior art, and a backward-compatible v1.1 IR hardening profile is admitted to represent cross-surface continuations and unresolved sign-identity conflicts without destructive merging or semantic promotion. None of these R3C results supply the independent alternate-editorial source bytes required by R3B, establish a new linguistic anchor, or constitute a decipherment. Additionally, a real-source coverage audit established that the four externally seeded D5 splits are mechanically present in the current mwenge source but the flat source exposes only newline/line-break witnesses and does not resolve whether each boundary is a physical surface transition or a ruled-line transition. An additive v1.2.1 hardening profile is admitted, preserving v1.1 and the base IR format while representing SOURCE_CONTINUATION_ACROSS_BOUNDARY with SURFACE, LINE, or UNRESOLVED_SURFACE_OR_LINE classes and fail-closed claim-view policies. A seven-document minimal source-span projection has passed cumulative base/v1.1/v1.2.1 validation and negative/positive scientific-view firewall canaries for all four D5 and three D6 cases. These are technical source-span projections, not full-document transcriptions; D5 boundary kind and linguistic wordhood remain unresolved, and D6 assigns no semantics to A319/*904. The R3C-3 corrective language-match lane is now methodologically frozen against Nepal and Perono Cacciafoco (2024): the five-language family is fixed, the primary unit is the complete raw exact consonant-cluster match universe before manual semantic filtering, two pre-frozen matched null families and max-stat familywise control are implemented, and the runner passes deterministic synthetic validation. Scientific execution remains blocked because no paper-exact study-input receipt or admitted upstream normalization contract is present. The public packaged application and README are methodological prior art, not substitutes for paper-exact input identity. Therefore no published language match has been reproduced by this gate and no language-family relationship, anchor, independent transcription replication, or decipherment is established. A separate R3D historical-source lane has now reconstructed the identity and provenance of Petrolito et al. (2015), a Linear A TEI-EpiDoc/Unicode digital corpus derived from Younger transcription material and manually checked against GORILA. Because this lineage is shared with established transcription traditions, JANUS classifies it conservatively as L1 independent digitization with GORILA editorial checking, not L2/L3 independent transcription evidence. Recovery, acquisition-receipt and XML security/schema gates are implemented and CI-validated, but no corpus bytes have been recovered, no XML document content has been inspected, and no R3D source adapter has been executed. R3B remains unchanged and independently blocked. External-source acquisition is now hardened by a generic non-executing quarantine gate that records original SHA-256/byte identity, safely inventories ZIP/TAR members and hashes streamable member payloads without filesystem extraction or semantic parsing, while rejecting unsafe archive structures and explicitly withholding provenance/R3B admission. A current operational acquisition matrix places true alternate-editorial R3B source bytes first. For RILA-S1, a lawful CNR request-copy/author-contact route is now documented, but no request has been sent and the visible restricted frontmatter/index attachment is not treated as transcription-bearing source evidence. Additional Stage-2 primary-method evidence narrows R3C-3 input/preprocessing behavior but does not complete the normalization contract or permit scientific execution. The historical NTU project site is a recovery gateway only; no site archive or attachment bytes have been recovered. The R3B acquisition lane is now operationally ready across three independent lawful routes ranked RILA-S1, CTLA and TMT. For RILA-S1, official publisher metadata confirms that a full digital PDF edition exists and an institutional EFA Academia document object advertises a free-PDF route whose preview reaches transcription-bearing sections, but JANUS has not acquired or hashed the PDF bytes and the current tool transport cannot retrieve the attachment. CTLA and TMT request routes are prepared, but neither has acquired bytes or an admitted independence class. Therefore P0 readiness is an acquisition-state result only: zero requests sent, zero source bytes acquired, zero R3B0 receipts, and external transcription replication remains blocked. JANUS has now recovered and quarantined the exact public historical 2021 Mac software bundle, reconstructed key normalization/matching control flow and dataflow without executing upstream code, and executed a pre-frozen 12-cell four-language historical stress test with two 10,000-iteration null families and max-statistic FWER. The outcome is discordant: zero cells clear both nulls; only the P1 raw-numbered Ancient Egyptian and Hittite cells clear N1 alone, while the pooled length-stratified N2 yields no excess for them. The historical code-derived P3 profile yields no robust positive excess for any of the four languages. This does not reproduce the 2024 paper because Uralic and paper-exact input/version provenance remain unavailable; it does not establish language family, cognacy, translation, phonetic correctness, independent transcription replication, an anchor, or decipherment. JANUS has now acquired and quarantined the exact current public Windows software bundle and statically compared its plaintext method source to the recovered 2021 historical source. Five of seven predeclared historical resource targets remain byte-identical, including Complied_Gorilla and four language dictionaries; no Uralic-named resource is present. Seven of eleven predeclared target-function occurrences are normalized-AST identical and four differ. The primary historical General Decipherment path remains structurally continuous, while a secondary path changed. BaseSheet moved from CSV to XLSX but preserves A1:C1336 and the same three headers. These facts narrow software lineage but do not identify the exact 2024 study snapshot or inputs, reproduce the paper, establish a language relationship, change R3B, create an anchor, or decipher Linear A. JANUS has now enumerated the complete reachable public Git package lineage of the Nepal/Perono software repository: 40 commits, 38 unique trees, and six unique ZIP blobs. Across all six public package snapshots, 4,861 central-directory member names were audited without reading member payloads; zero Uralic-named members were found. Static AST audit of both recovered historical and current plaintext Python sources likewise found zero Uralic-name bindings, while strong positive controls for Ancient Egyptian, Luwian, Hittite, and Proto-Celtic were present in both versions. The historical main loader accepts a user-selected external file and the current main loader is normalized-AST identical, so an external/user-supplied Uralic input channel is now supported as the best public-provenance inference. It remains unproved, a differently named packaged input remains possible, and the exact 2024 study input is still unavailable. No paper reproduction, language-family inference, R3B change, anchor, or decipherment is established.

R3C_3_historical_public_software_stress.interpretation: Large raw exact-match counts in P1 are representation/null-model sensitive. Ancient Egyptian and Hittite clear N1 after max-12 FWER but fail N2, where their observed unique-hit counts are below the pooled length-stratified null means. The historical code-derived P3 profile produces no robust positive excess under either null family. This is a corrective negative/discordant result, not evidence for a language-family relationship.

R3C_3_current_public_software_provenance.interpretation: The current public Windows distribution preserves Complied_Gorilla and the four historical Ancient Egyptian, Luwian, Hittite, and Proto-Celtic dictionary files byte-for-byte, still exposes no Uralic-named resource, and includes plaintext current Python source. Across 11 predeclared historical/current target-function occurrences, 7 are normalized-AST identical and 4 differ. The historical main General Decipherment loader/update path is structurally continuous, while the secondary rem_vowel/updateGeneralDeciphermentTable2/openFileDialog1/openFileDialog2 path changed. BaseSheet changed container CSV to XLSX but retains A1:C1336 and the headers Source / NEW FORMAT / Linear A. This narrows software provenance but does not identify the exact 2024 study snapshot.

R3C_3_Uralic_public_provenance_audit.provenance_inference: Because Uralic is absent by name from all six public package snapshots and from both recovered plaintext source versions, while the software contains a user-selected external file loader and the current main loader is structurally identical to the historical one, an external/user-supplied Uralic input channel is now the best-supported public-provenance explanation. This is an inference, not proof; a differently named packaged resource remains logically possible.
